integrity: The infinite bound and the sharp constructions are proved symbolically. The bundled exhaustive computation through length 9 and construction replay through length 30 are consistency checks rather than extrapolation. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns the ordered ternary alphabet with standard weights 1, 2, 3. It does not characterize full equivalence classes or give the corresponding extremal Parikh distortion for larger alphabets or gapful measures.
title: Exact ternary Parikh distortion of weighted prefix normalization
